details.description: Base Conversational AI is a Deepgram speech-to-text model in Deepgram's Base tier, tuned specifically for human-bot interactions such as IVR systems and voice assistants rather than general-purpose recordings. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview lists Base, together with Enhanced and Nova (1), under "Legacy Models", and documents base-conversationalai for English only. It is built on Deepgram's end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text architecture.
advantages: Tuned specifically for human-bot voice interactions such as IVR systems and voice assistants, per Deepgram's Model Options page.
Deepgram describes Base-tier models as offering a combination of accuracy and cost-effectiveness built on its end-to-end deep learning speech-to-text architecture, per Deepgram's Model Options page.
disadvantages: Deepgram lists the Base tier under "Legacy Models" in its Models & Languages Overview.

Deepgram describes its Enhanced tier as having higher accuracy and better word recognition than Base models, including significantly better handling of uncommon words, per Deepgram's Model Options page.
Supports English only, per Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview.
use_cases: Transcribing human-bot voice interactions such as IVR systems and voice assistants, per Deepgram's Model Options page.

notes: No word-error-rate or other accuracy figure specific to base-conversationalai was found on Deepgram's maker pages, so evaluations is left empty. Deepgram's Models & Languages Overview groups Base under 'Legacy Models', though the catalog carries no deprecation_date.
